bounds.domain: Two callers, each with at most two first-use calls, two shared initialization attempts, one SQL schema change and at most one initialization failure. Read and capture callers share the same initializer.
assumptions: Weak fairness assumes enabled schema inspection, migration, publication and caller observation settle. The first attempt may fail; after that one allowed failure a started retry succeeds. No retry occurs until a later caller requests storage, and no permanent database failure or wall-clock deadline is proved.

SQL inspection and migration are separate model transitions. A failed initialization may leave a committed schema update; a retry observes it instead of repeating the ALTER. The production PGlite regression exercises concurrent readers against a legacy table.

The instance assumes an adapter with SQL support. Stop does not undo admitted schema changes. Capture admission, effect durability, query payloads, unsupported adapters, later schema mutation and arbitrary database/provider schedules remain outside this initializer projection. Existing capture and stop ownership are not replaced.
